summary: Southern Company Gas Capital Corporation, a wholly-owned subsidiary of Southern Company Gas acting as guarantor, filed a preliminary prospectus supplement under Rule 424(b)(5) for a public offering of Series 2026A senior notes due a future date. Terms including principal amount, coupon and maturity are left blank in this preliminary filing, with pricing expected around September 2026 and semi-annual interest beginning 2027. The notes are unsecured and unsubordinated, fully and unconditionally guaranteed by the parent, ranking equally with existing unsecured obligations. Joint book-running managers are BofA Securities, MUFG, PNC Capital Markets and Wells Fargo Securities. This is a routine debt shelf takedown, not a special situation.
